notes: Official TPS Digital Services branding (Charte Graphique / BrandingPresentation V3.0, Drive folder 'Branding'). Noir #1A1A1A and Jaune #FFBB10 are the two brand colors; Blanc #FFFFFF and Gris #F2F2F2 are the neutral backgrounds. Typeface is Space Grotesk — falls back to a system sans-serif if not installed on the machine rendering the PDF. kpi_positive/kpi_negative aren't part of the brand palette (it has no red/green); they stay as generic delta indicators unless the client specifies otherwise. logo.png is 'LogoMark-Dark' (dark logo, for use on light backgrounds) from the Drive Logo Mark/PNG folder — swap in LogoMark-White.png instead if a dark report background is ever used.
